versions.request: Reconstruct or upgrade a park or amenity (i.e. playground, outdoor athletic field)
versions.explanation: This is a request to upgrade the play equipment and surface at Willow Lake Playground with accessible, state-of-the-art play equipment, cooling features such as spray showers, shade structures (e.g., gazebos), permeable turf over infiltration basins, and heat-resistant play surfaces. Our community is increasingly affected by extreme heat, and families in CB 6 are relying more than ever on public playgrounds as accessible and affordable spaces for their children to play. Willow Lake playground,one of the most heavily used in our district,must be upgraded to meet these demands. We urgently need a safe, climate-resilient, and inclusive space where children can play even during dangerously hot weather. It's time our community received a modern, state-of-the-art playground that reflects the needs of today and prepares for the challenges of tomorrow.
versions.response: The agency recommends funding this budget request, but at this time the availability of funds is uncertain. OMB supports the agency's position.
